repair.implementation: One dependency-free helper using native Chromium CDP Fetch interception for finite and SSE requests. Removes the preflight GET, route.fetch/fulfill/continue transports and duplicated caller helpers.
repair.credentials: Fetch.continueRequest header overrides apply to one actual request only. Exact pinned HTTPS BFF origin includes port. Each redirect is intercepted independently; foreign origin never receives this bearer. Same-origin redirect gets pinned auth. Browser storage, URL tokens and cookie-based substitutes are not used.
repair.registration: Existing pages are awaited at installation; page events attach future pages, and both callers await transport.attachPage before any protected request.
repair.tenant: Remove all frontend X-Tenant-Id case variants on pinned requests; preserve authenticated default or apply the same explicit override to finite and streaming requests.
repair.errors: CDP failure is recorded and the paused request failed; both callers settle pending observations and fail health checks. Network failures include SSE, even though route-load excludes SSE lifecycle from readiness. Ignore ERR_ABORTED only after verified page/context closure or frame navigation; ignore closed/disposed/detached protocol errors only if target really closed. Error text redacts the synthetic or supplied token.
repair.boundaries: Same FE/local-candidate origin validation, content readiness milestones, timeouts, samples, latency limits, strict auth and aggregate gates. Pure bearer normalizer and evidence redactor unchanged; no new package/proxy/service/framework.
